presets.label: Centered main, stack on the right
Centered main, stacks on both sides
Smart: changes with the number of windows
presets.description: Smart picks the layout from how many windows are open and the monitor's shape: one window gets the screen (the middle of an ultrawide), and each new window reshapes the layout so they all fit.

presets.label: Dwindle (Omarchy's default)
presets.description: Dwindle, Omarchy's default: each new window splits the focused one in half.

presets.label: Scrolling
presets.description: Scrolling: windows sit side by side on a strip that can be wider than the screen. Moving focus scrolls to them.

presets.label: Monocle: one window at a time
presets.description: Monocle: every window fills the screen, one in front of the others. Moving focus brings the next one to the front.
